c74object.name: el.killdc~
c74object.description:
el.killdc~ is a steep DC-blocking filter designed to remove 0 Hz DC offset and subsonic bias from audio signals without attenuating or coloring audible low frequencies. The design is based on Paul Lansky's cascaded elliptic filter implementation in Cmix.
Inlets
Inlet 1 (signal / messages): Audio signal input to be filtered, and control message inlet (clear, mute).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): DC-filtered audio output signal.

inlet.description: Incoming audio signal to be filtered of DC offset, as well as control messages (clear, mute).

outlet.description: The filtered audio output with 0 Hz DC component removed.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the internal filter delay memory and resets filter states to zero.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), normal DC-filtering resumes.

method.name: signal
method.description: Incoming audio signal to be processed.
